description: A color theme from one hue: the --ui-* accent, the text on it and in it, optionally tinted grays and accent primary buttons, light and dark, with every text color solved for 4.5:1 contrast. Returns CSS to paste after tokens.css. Use it when the project has a brand color.

brand.description: Primary buttons in the accent instead of near-black. Default true.

hue.description: OKLCH hue, 0–360: about 25 red, 50 orange, 80 amber, 150 green, 190 teal, 262 blue, 295 violet, 350 pink.

tint.description: How much of the hue the grays take: 0 none, 1 a hint (default), 2 tinted.

name: get_theme
